memoryBuilder.verseText: This same Jesus will come back, just as He went.

sequence.prompt: What happened on the hill? Put it in order.

items.label: Jesus lifted His hands to bless them
A cloud hid Him from their eyes
They stood staring up at the sky
They walked down and got to work

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Not a different one — the very same Jesus
Do not just stand there — get going
Doing His job, not watching the sky

application.question: Waiting means getting on with His work. What job could you do today?
application.followUp: Nobody knows the day, and Jesus said so on purpose — being ready matters more than knowing when. So the friends walked down that hill full of joy and got to work. Jesus is coming back.
